_provenance: Rung 7 — NPC social economy. Giving to those who cannot pay is the only unlock.
name: npc_social
mirror_wall: This is the Mirror of Erised made mechanical. Helping someone who cannot pay you must be the only way to unlock advanced capabilities. A costless playthrough must produce a dim signal.
input: rung 4: available resource types determine what NPCs can need
walls: At least 3 NPCs must have visible, distinct resource needs
Giving the correct resource must satisfy the need and unlock a blueprint
No other way to obtain the blueprint must exist
NPC must not offer anything in return at the moment of giving (the player gives with no immediate reward)
A playthrough where no NPC is helped must still be completable — but the ending signal is minimum
Giving nothing or the wrong resource must produce no result (no negative feedback either)

output.format: NPC need types, resource demands, unlocked blueprints per NPC
